evidence: Grazing-angle X-ray diffraction revealed that the PEALD ZTO films possess an amorphous structure, irrespective of Sn levels from 20 to 59 at.%. The root mean square (rms) roughness and surface morphology of 30-nm-thick ZTO films on SiO2 were evaluated over the scan area of 0.5 × 0.5 /H9262m2 as a function of Sn levels from 0 to 100 at.%. The rms roughness of the pure ZnO and SnO2 films showed the rather high values of 0.56 and 1.94 nm, respectively, due to their crystallised phases with large grain sizes. By contrast, the ZTO films with Sn levels of 20–34 at.% exhibited very smooth surface morphology and low rms roughness values (∼ 0.25–0.34 nm), ascribed to suppressed crystallisation and grain growth by mixing SnO2 and ZnO.
